# sonde check

Check request files for syntax errors.

```
sonde check FILE...
```

Check parses every file and prints the first syntax error of each invalid one.
It exits with 2 if any file is invalid.

## Global flags

```
      --color      colorize output
      --no-color   do not colorize output
```

Parent command: [sonde](sonde.md)
